title: Norm bounds on Fourier series with polynomial spectra and constrained coefficients
summary: The goal of this paper is to prove an upper bound for the $L^4$ norm of a trigonometric polynomial whose spectrum is a nontrivial strictly monotone polynomial with integer coefficients of degree three and higher, via its $L^2$ norm. Our condition on the coefficients of the trigonometric polynomial in question is that they form a complex sequence whose modulus is decreasing. Second, we obtain a similar result in the case where the spectrum is formed by perfect squares, under a more strict condition on the coefficients. Our results strengthen and complement those by S.
